# Claude Code + Codex Google Ads Skill

> Agent-readable Google Ads skill for Claude Code, Codex, and AI coding agents. Covers 2026 strategy, Smart Bidding, AI Max, keyword research, auction analysis, experiments, optimization, GAQL, and report generation.

## Start here

- `README.md`: public overview, installation, topics, and security notes.
- `SKILL.md`: primary skill entry point and routing logic.
- `AGENTS.md`: instructions for coding agents working in this repository.
- `CLAUDE.md`: Claude Code bridge.
- `.github/copilot-instructions.md`: GitHub Copilot instructions.

## Deep references

- `references/01-strategy.md`: Smart Bidding, AI Max, attribution, audiences.
- `references/02-keyword-research.md`: intent mapping, match types, n-gram, SQR mining.
- `references/03-bidding-and-auction.md`: bidding strategies and Auction Insights.
- `references/04-campaign-creation.md`: campaign setup, RSAs, extensions, negatives.
- `references/05-ab-testing.md`: experiments and significance.
- `references/06-optimization-playbook.md`: daily, weekly, monthly optimization and diagnosis.
- `references/07-reporting-and-gaql.md`: GAQL queries and Google Ads Script templates.

## Local scripts

- `scripts/build_report.py`: internal monthly `.docx` report template.
- `scripts/build_report_cliente.py`: client-facing `.docx` report template.
- `scripts/n_gram_analysis.py`: search term n-gram analysis from CSV exports.
- `scripts/README.md`: script usage.

## Constraints

- This is not a runnable web app, API, or hosted service.
- Do not commit credentials, customer IDs, account IDs, real search-term exports, or generated client reports.
- Load `SKILL.md` first, then only the reference file relevant to the user's Google Ads task.
